Legacy Education Inc. (NYSE: LGCY) is a nationally accredited, for-profit, public education company focused on providing a high-quality education that is accessible and affordable.
We proudly operate 6 academic institutions in California, including HighDesert Medical College, Integrity College of Health, Central Coast College, and Contra Costa Medical Career College.
With multiple campuses and schools serving diverse communities, Legacy Education is shaping the future of healthcare one student at a time.
Explore our map to see where students are training, growing, and stepping into new careers in healthcare.
By offering a wide range of award winning educational programs, we provide students with a marketable path to achieve their professional goals and strive for a legacy of excellence.
Education with Purpose, Careers with Impact

The mission of Legacy Education is to educate students in career specific disciplines in the areas of allied health that match industry demands. We are committed to offering a quality educational experience, and assistance in individualized placement so graduates can utilize their knowledge and skills to enter their chosen career fields.
Transforming Lives Beyond the Classroom
Our students and staff make a difference every day by volunteering, donating, and supporting those in need. Discover how each of our colleges is creating positive change in their local communities.

Gain a deeper understanding of the trends shaping today’s workforce. Explore key data, research, and analysis that highlight how career-focused education prepares students for real opportunities in today’s rapidly growing industries.

What if you woke up every morning looking forward to supporting someone on their Path to Purpose? Join Legacy Education and you can make an impact in the lives of students, staff and a community for a greater tomorrow.

pages.raw_meta: Meet Legacy Education: nationally accredited, award-winning allied health programs at 4 schools on 6 campuses. Explore our mission, values, and approvals.
raw_blocks: Founded in 2009, Legacy Education is a nationally accredited, for-profit education company focused on providing a high-quality education that is accessible and affordable.

Headquartered in Lancaster, California, we proudly own and operate 4 schools on 6 campuses. By offering a wide range of award-winning educational programs, we provide post-secondary students with a marketable path to achieve their professional goals and strive for a legacy of excellence.
Through our outstanding programs and expert leadership, we are committed to growing our educational footprint through organic enrollment growth, program expansion, and acquisitions.

The mission of Legacy Education is to educate students in career specific disciplines in the areas of allied health that match industry demands. We are committed to offering a quality educational experience, and assistance in individualized placement so graduates can utilize their knowledge and skills to enter their chosen career fields.
In pursuit of this mission, Legacy Education is guided by the following core values, principles and objectives:
Integrity – By constantly striving for the best in education, we remain true to our mission, our vision, and our commitment to students, faculty, staff and investors.

Ambition – The pursuit of education has at its very core a sound work ethic, a burning motivation, and an insatiable drive. These qualities nourish our venture and drive us forward in achieving our goals.

Creativity – Our inventive spirits and industrious imaginations fuel our efforts to consistently situate the company on the leading edge of its field, and offer the latest innovations in instructional techniques and technologies.

Teamwork – While we started with a close-knit, loyal group of educators, more than 30 years ago, its true legacy will be the spirit of constructive collaboration it inspires in its students, faculty and staff.

High Desert Medical College, Central Coast College and Contra Costa Medical Career College are accredited by the Accrediting Council for Continuing Education & Training (ACCET) – A Partnership for Quality® ACCET is listed by the U.S. Department of Education as a nationally recognized accrediting agency.
1722 N St NW Washington, DC 20036 Phone: 202-955-1113 Fax: 202-955-1118 www.accet.org

All Legacy Education colleges are licensed by the Bureau for Private Postsecondary Education (BPPE). Licensed to operate means the institution is in compliance with the state standards as set forth in the California Private Postsecondary Education Act of 2009, Ed. Code §94897.
2535 Capitol Oaks Dr, Ste 400 Sacramento, CA 95833 Phone: 916-431-6959 Toll Free: 888-370-7589 www.bppe.ca.gov
The Licensed Vocational Nursing programs at all Legacy Education colleges are approved by the California Board of Vocational Nursing and Psychiatric Technicians (BVNPT).
2535 Capitol Oaks Dr, Ste 205 Sacramento, CA 95833 Phone: 916-263-7800 www.bvnpt.ca.gov

The Veterinary Technology program at Central Coast College has been awarded full Accreditation by the Council on Veterinary Technical Education and Activities of the American Veterinary Medical Association – AVMA .
1931 North Meacham Road, Suite 100 Schaumburg, IL 60173-4360 Phone: 800-248-2862 www.avma.org
The MRI & Ultrasound Tech programs at High Desert Medical College are approved by the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT).
1255 Northland Drive St. Paul, MN 55120-1155 Phone: 651-687-0048 www.arrt.org
Pharmacy Tech programs at Central Coast College and Contra Costa Medical Career College are recognized as Pharmacy Technician Certification Board programs.
2215 Constitution Avenue NW, Suite 101 Washington DC 20037 ptcb.org
The Surgical Technology program at Contra Costa Medical Career College is programmatically accredited by the Accrediting Bureau of Health Education Schools (ABHES).
6116 Executive Blvd, Rockville, MD 20852 Phone: (301) 291-7550 www.abhes.org .
Integrity College of Health maintains Institutional Accreditation with the Accrediting Bureau of Health Education Schools (ABHES).
6116 Executive Blvd Rockville, MD 20852 Phone: (301) 291-7550 www.abhes.org .
The RN-BSN program at ICH is programmatically accredited by NLN Commission for Nursing Education Accreditation (NLN CNEA).
The Integrity College of Health Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing Program holds initial accreditation from the National League for Nursing Commission for Nursing Education Accreditation (NLN CNEA)
2600 Virginia Avenue, NW Washington, DC 20037 Phone: 202-909-2487 cnea.nln.org

LeeAnn Rohmann founded Legacy Education to support her strong belief in higher education as the basis for building a legacy for students and their families. She is passionate about providing the best training in the strongest industries like healthcare. LeeAnn began her career in higher education more than 25 years ago and has spent every day since working to provide education opportunities.
Legacy Education wins the 2025 CECU Community Impact Award
Claudia Barajas of Legacy Education wins the 2025 Norma Ford Financial Aid Professional of the Year
Legacy Education receives the 2022 CAPPS Excellence in Community Service Award
Legacy Education wins 2020 CAPPS School of the Year
